_comment: mini-dudeai standalone (dude-claw) rules seed. Copied to ~/mini_dudeai_claw_rules.json on first boot by presets/standalone.py (only when absent); the daemon promotes ~/mini_dudeai_claw_rules.json.candidate over it afterwards. The chip-temp pair is the Phase A end-to-end demo: breach held grace_s -> LED red + page; recovery -> LED off + quiet cleared notice. No operator-specific values here (MF014) — device/topic/thresholds live in the claw env file.

rules.annotation: Phase A demo actuator leg: chip temp held over threshold for a minute turns the claw's RGB LED red; recovery turns it off. State-set payloads only — safe under the #81 retry queue.
Phase A demo page leg: same breach as chip_temp_hot_led, paged to the operator. Threshold lives in MINI_DUDEAI_CLAW_TEMP_THRESHOLD (default 55C).

Display leg (fw >=0.4.0+dudeclaw.15): the RED chip-temp page also paints the OLED alert banner (class + locally-ticking age — a paging witness that survives ntfy loss via the #81 retry queue); recovery clears it EXPLICITLY (empty class is the only clear). SINGLE-BANNER CONSTRAINT: the glass has one banner — keep exactly ONE display_alert leg in this ruleset until the firmware learns class-matched clears, because a second leg's edge_down would clear the other's still-active banner. claw_blind deliberately has no display leg: its target is dark by definition, and queued paints delivering out-of-band on recovery are noise, not signal.

W7 edge anomaly witness (fw branch pr/anomaly-witness): the claw's anomaly_stats leads with max |z| vs self-learned EW baselines; -1 while learning, so a gt threshold can never breach during warm-up. INERT until the sensor is enabled in MINI_DUDEAI_CLAW_SENSORS with an entry like {device: <your MINI_DUDEAI_CLAW_DEVICE value>, sensor: anomaly, tool: anomaly_stats, threshold: 4.0, op: gt} — 'device' is REQUIRED (NatsSensorSource refuses to build without it, and a device-less entry crashloops the daemon at startup); do that only after the firmware carrying the tool is flashed. Witness, not actuator: default-priority note, the operator (or frontier) decides what a deviation means.

Blindness is its own signal (unobservable != healthy): NATS bus down, device off WiFi, or unparseable readings. grace_s rides out transient WiFi blips; sustained darkness pages. While dark, the engine HOLDS last-good breach conditions, so a hot claw cannot read as 'recovered' by going silent.
